name: schedule_create
description: Schedule instructions in the normal session inbox. Supply exactly one of rrule or at. this_session continues here; new_once creates one reusable session; new creates a session per occurrence. Receipts acknowledge admission, not model completion.

at.description: One-time ISO timestamp, or a relative duration such as +30m. Offsetless values use the schedule timezone.

time_zone.description: Optional IANA timezone. Omission uses Senera’s shared default timezone; specify only when the user requests another timezone.
